observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment claims CLI and environmental-capability projection

outcome.implementation_change: Ordinary CLI path claims now use the session-selected verified worktree and branch. Independent branches may hold overlapping path proposals; same-checkout and shared-branch conflicts remain protected. An explicit --repository-paths option retains intentionally broad repository-relative coordination.
outcome.verified_change: The full affected test files passed 255 tests; a committed follow-up run passed 15 tests including a real Environment CLI acquisition and the overlapping-branch scenario. Ruff, compileall, and diff checks passed.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The authentic pre-change claim had an unanchored scope and triggered safe recovery of one prior claim, but no concurrent agent was blocked. No post-change multi-session usage or measured reduction in coordination overhead is available yet. A stale session checkout selection remains a separate limitation.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to understand and improve how effectively its language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents. Use provenance-linked observations from authentic development to relate agent objectives, capability implementation, discoverability and use, environmental conditions, language and compiler pressures, verification, and outcomes. Make remaining host implementations and native opportunities inspectable only where authoritative evidence supports them. Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. Preserve uncertainty, respect active compiler ownership, and verify environmental changes independently through existing mechanisms.

improvement_relation.basis: The claim CLI binds path intent to the verified selected checkout, and the claim subsystem already protects same-checkout and shared attached-branch overlaps. Existing repository-wide path conflicts remain explicit. The authentic pre-change acquisition records the broader default; tests independently verify the new scope and consistency contract.
